experiment: Identical ridge-logistic probes on frozen MSE20 and BCE20 feature representations
scope: Exploratory continuation on the repeatedly inspected141validation Fridays in2018-2020. No independent-confirmation, complete-paper-replication, trading-profitability or deployment claim. No new market data or neural training.
features: Use the25flattened decoded_features immediately before the native Linear25-to-1 readout. Freeze all tensors in18existing epoch20 models, including backbone/geometry/decoder/heads. Extract under eval and inference_mode with requires_grad=False. No dropout augmentation. Each supervised backbone used only its own pre-cutoff training labels; its training-period features are in-sample representations and their probe training scores are not out-of-sample evidence.
data: Reuse original1678,1921,2165training rows with joint_completed<=cutoff, raw-return>0 binary labels, invalid-OHLC exclusions and49,46,46weekly validation masks. Only training features are extracted before probe fitting. Extract validation features and make new validation forecasts only after all18probe heads finish and their convergence checks pass.

standardization.description: For each model independently, compute25feature means and population SDs on its training rows only. Standardize each coordinate with those frozen statistics; use the same statistics at validation. Per-coordinate scaling is not invariant to rotations of a representation.

probe.objective: Mean unweighted binary log loss plus lambda/2 times sum of squared slopes in standardized coordinates. Intercept is not penalized. No auxiliary or return loss. Initialize slopes0 and intercept logit(training_up_frequency). Same single regularization value and full-batch float64 Newton solver for both families. No lambda, window, feature, seed or threshold search.

budget: Exactly18primary probe fits=2frozen feature families*3cutoffs*3inherited seeds,26coefficients each. No neural optimizer steps or backbone changes. Record actual Newton iterations and gradient norms; stop on nonconvergence before validation. Independent SciPy L-BFGS-B solutions are verification only, never forecast candidates.

independent_solver.purpose: Verification only; never substitute its coefficients for the primary Newton solution.

training_diagnostics: For every head report objective, log loss, Brier, accuracy, AUROC, gradient infinity norm, Hessian minimum eigenvalue, feature SD/rank and probability dispersion. Compare against causal training-frequency probability. For BCE backbones additionally express the native BCE head in standardized coordinates and evaluate the SAME ridge objective. Lower probe objective is expected at the convex optimum; do not call this proof that the previous end-to-end optimizer was defective, since dropout, objective, regularization and feature scaling differ.
validation: Reuse846old seed forecasts (MSE20 and BCE20), produce846new probe seed probabilities, average the three seed PROBABILITIES per family and use strict p>0.5. Preserve original raw-return-sign ensemble and training-frequency/neutral0.5 references. Six ensemble methods on the same141weeks. No probability calibration, confidence filtering or threshold fitting. Original raw returns do not receive invented probability scores.
metrics: Direction accuracy/error, balanced accuracy, confusion counts, predicted-up fraction, AUROC; Brier/log loss/probability moments for probability methods only. Log-loss reporting clips p to[1e-12,1-1e-12] with clip counts; predictions and decisions are unchanged. Five fixed equal-width reliability bins, including empty bins. Report all years and inherited seeds.
inference: Seven prespecified paired weekly ensemble loss contrasts, candidate minus reference (negative is better). Circular8-observation blocks,10000replicates,seed20260910,centered two-sided p; Holm across all seven. Percentile95% intervals are descriptive and need not invert the centered tests. No claim to cover repeated historical selection, backbone/probe fitting uncertainty, or independence of overlapping folds/seeds.
descriptive_screen: Evaluate BOTH probe families separately under the same8flags, using original MSE20 as the research reference for both: ensemble accuracy beats original and training-frequency decision; ensemble Brier and log loss beat training frequency; at least2/3matched seeds beat original accuracy; at least2/3seeds beat training-frequency Brier; at least2/3years beat original accuracy; at least2/3years beat training-frequency Brier. All8needed per family; report ties as not passing. No outcome-dependent candidate substitution or automatic promotion.
verification: Freeze protocol,core sources,input hashes and2479previous evidence files. Test analytic objective/gradient/Hessian, unpenalized intercept, solver convergence, feature normalization and real-model readout reconstruction. Replay all18feature extractors over34584training rows and846validation rows; verify unchanged model tensors/bytes. Verify all18solutions independently with SciPy L-BFGS-B starting at zero slopes, objective agreement<=1e-10, max training-probability difference<=1e-5, and independent gradient infinity norm<=5e-7. Replay846new and846old seed forecasts, original ensemble rules, all metrics/reliability and7paired comparisons. Independent optimizers and diagnostics never alter selected coefficients or forecasts.
